title: Fit the red gel frame in a 3 in fresnel before the lamp is struck
instruction: Put the red gel in the light.
context: A colour frame holding gel gets hot once an incandescent fixture has been on (University of Rochester lighting-lab notes). Gels must sit in the fixture's colour runners, not on the lens: gels placed directly on a hot lens can melt or burn (CINE-340 electrical and set safety). Pre-hang practice is to fit the framed gel in the runners while the lamp is still on the bench, before it is struck, so the accessory is in place before the fixture can become a fire risk. This task is that fit: a 3.75 in red frame starts flat on the bench, clear of the lamp, and has to be picked up, lined up with both holders, and slid in to the stop. A blue frame in a gel box beside the lamp is not in the runners. The trial is cold and unpowered. IATSE lighting notes: more saturated gels absorb more heat and can melt. The fixture sits on its back, lens up, as when a lamp is gelled on the bench before it is hung.
setup: An Altman Lighting CAT #100 3 in Inky (black epoxy sandtex body, 3 in Pyrex stepped lens, plated-steel yoke, 510-B-style C-clamp, black focus thumbscrew and door knob) sits on the bench on its back, lens pointing up, as when a lamp is gelled before it is hung. It is unpowered; there is no lamp and no heat. Its colour-frame holders open along +y, with a stop at -y. A 3.75 x 3.75 in (Altman 100-CFB size) aluminium colour frame already holds a pre-cut red Rosco (or LEE) gel and starts flat on the bench, further +y, clear of both holders. The red face is a clear table-middle cue. A short post and pinch bar on the trailing edge are for a straight-down grip. A second, blue, frame lies in a shallow gel box beside the lamp and is not in the holders. All props are rigid and start on fixed marks.
scoring: As seen in the overhead video, the red frame is in both colour-frame holders. At the end, after 1 s at rest and with the gripper clear of the frame: 1.0 once the frame is on the stop (within 10 mm) and has been let go; 0.5 if the frame has entered the holders but is still short of the stop, or if it is on the stop but has not been let go or is not yet still; 0.25 if it is only near the mouth; 0 for the start pose on the bench, clear of the lamp, and for any path that never enters the holders. Possible scores: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0.
reset_notes: Put the red frame back on its start mark on the bench, flat and clear of both holders. The blue frame stays in the gel box. The lamp is unpowered.
fidelity: Dressed from the Altman 100: black sandtex, plated yoke and C-clamp, black hardware, 3 in lens, 3.75 in frame. The red frame is free, not a slider, and starts on the bench. Holders opened to about 20 mm (PhysX contactOffset is 4 mm; a real 3-5 mm runner is not used). The body is 70 mm, not the real 190 mm barrel — a flagged REACH trade-off, not a hidden shrink. The pull tab is a short post and 16 mm bar, chunkier than a real 100-CFB tab, so the grip can close on it. Cold; no lamp is struck.
scores: Scripted (yam_arena, 320x176, seed 0; Brev L40S, v11): demo 1.0 (step 340); short 0.5; idle 0.0; naive 0.0. Dream-1 flash (seed 1, 22 Nov 2026): 0.0 in 500 steps, not refused (20 requests, 27 attempts).
